en: Black‑and‑white seaside view showing people walking on a promenade with a balustrade. At the end of the pier stands an ornate Art Nouveau building on the Black Sea shore — the famous casino. Reverse side has Romanian printed headings, a purple Romanian stamp commemorating "zece ani dela eliberare 1944–1954," a Constanța postmark, and a handwritten message/address in Romanian.
